description: Search Indeed job listings by title, location and country: 25 jobs with employer, salary when listed, job type, posted date, description and link as JSON. Use it when: You need broad job coverage, including roles that are not posted on LinkedIn. Not for: Company research or people data. Returns: 25 jobs: title, employer, location, salary when listed, job types, benefits, posted date, description and link. Typical time: about 7 s. Price: $0.006 per search (up to 25 jobs), charged only on success. One call = up to 25 jobs.

country.description: Two-letter country code, lowercase, e.g. us, gb, de; default us

location.description: City and state or region, e.g. Chicago, IL

title.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. data analyst

name: indeed-jobs
title: Indeed job search
